test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: A dishonest shopkeeper sells goods to a customer at a profit of T% over the cost price and also weighs 800 g instead of 1 kg. His total profit percentage is 40%. What is the value of T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total profit multiplier = Markup multiplier × Weight error multiplier.

Given total profit is 40%, multiplier = 140/100 = 1.4.

Weight error multiplier = True Weight ÷ Faulty Weight = 1000 ÷ 800 = 1.25.

Markup multiplier (1 + T/100) = Total profit multiplier ÷ Weight error multiplier = 1.4 ÷ 1.25 = 1.12.

1 + T/100 = 1.12 ⇒ T/100 = 0.12 ⇒ T = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** CP per kg = Rs. 1000 (assumed), Customer pays for 1 kg but receives 800 g. Total Profit% = 40%.

**Formulas:** Total Profit% = [ (True Value − Error) × (100 + T) / (Error × 100) − 1 ] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4ae870bc9d74cde0b4f96b00725ce552c4535b5c663ca74e5b9d9c20a5d3a77.png] 

⇒ Let CP of 1 g = Rs. 1. So, CP of 1000 g = Rs. 1000 and CP of 800 g = Rs. 800.

⇒ The shopkeeper sells 800 g but charges for 1000 g at a profit of T%.

⇒ SP = 1000 × (100 + T) / 100 = 10 × (100 + T).

⇒ Total Profit% = [(SP − CP of 800g) / CP of 800g] × 100 = 40.

⇒ [10(100 + T) − 800] / 800 = 40 / 100 = 0.4.

⇒ 1000 + 10T − 800 = 320 ⇒ 200 + 10T = 320.

⇒ 10T = 120 ⇒ T = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer uses less weight, the **Effective Gain%** is calculated on the actual weight delivered to the customer. Formula: Gain% = [Error / (True Value − Error)] × 100.

Combined Profit

If there is both a price markup and a weight shortage, the **Overall Profit** is the result of successive multiplication of individual profit factors.</p
